segments.name: IT-related services
segments.description: Provides managed IT security, cloud hosting, backup, professional, procurement and web hosting services, plus ManyCam software, to businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company is a single-segment business.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay recurring fees, often under service-level agreements, for managed IT services and hosting.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers of our managed IT security services typically pay a recurring fee, often based on service-level agreements that define the specific services and performance metrics.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold Vumber, Paltalk and Camfrog and exited consumer video and telecom software.
changes.evidence: Following the Divestiture, we are no longer engaged in the business of providing video-based, live streaming, virtual camera and telecommunications software to consumers, as and to the extent such businesses were previously conducted by us pursuant to the Vumber, Paltalk and Camfrog applications.
